headline: Herobrine, Minecraft's ghost
title: Herobrine Explained | Minecraft's Biggest Urban Legend | Minecraft Facts
video_script: Herobrine is Minecraft's most famous urban legend. He looks like Steve, but with blank white eyes. The story started in two thousand ten, when an anonymous post on 4chan claimed a strange figure appeared in a player's single player world. Streamers made it famous, and Herobrine became a meme. Did you believe in Herobrine? Comment below!
description: Herobrine is a Minecraft urban legend and creepypasta: a Steve-like figure with blank white eyes, from an anonymous 2010 4chan /v/ post, popularised by livestreamers.
